subject: Urban Planning
subcategory: Parks, Green Spaces, and Public Land
title: Medellín's Green Corridors
description: A short lesson to help you apply Medellín's Green Corridors.

hook.text: Medellín planted 880,000 trees along 36 corridors. The city cooled by 2°C in three years.

buildup.text: The Green Corridors project turned roads and waterways into linear parks connecting neighborhoods.

discovery.text: Trees shade pavement, filter air, and absorb rain. The corridors are infrastructure disguised as landscaping.

twist.text: Medellín was once the world's murder capital. Green investment was part of its total urban transformation.

climax.text: The project cost $16.3 million — cheaper than air conditioning the same area would cost annually.

punchline.text: Plant trees along roads. Cool the city. Cheaper than any machine.

quiz.question: How much did Medellín's Green Corridors cool the city?
